verses: I also saw the soul of a man, at whose feet several children fell, and ever screamed, and demons, just like dogs, ever fell upon and tore him.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked man who, in the world, did not acknowledge his own children.'
